items.text:
This recent wave of COVID has overwhelmed our health care system. 
 
I urged @HHSgov to take action because our front line medical personnel are being stretched too thin. 

I'm relieved that @fema emergency medical staff are on their way to provide relief to our local hospitals.

The U.S. must put Putin on notice. 

Should criminal hackers within Russia’s borders threaten American hospitals, utilities, or other critical infrastructure, we should consider all tools at our disposal to respond to such aggression. 

https://t.co/TH8dm4r7Fc

Telehealth services are more than just a convenient tool during a pandemic. 

For people with disabilities, telehealth makes medical and mental health treatment more accessible.  

I’m fighting to make that permanent.

I am extraordinarily grateful to the Biden-Harris Administration for setting out to reduce cancer mortality rates by 50% and improve the quality of life for those in treatment. 

We’re going to beat this disease.

The American Rescue Plan lowered health care costs for millions of Americans by expanding insurance premium tax credits and making low-cost plans available to families who qualified. 
 
Last year, 31k uninsured Rhode Islanders gained health care coverage thanks to those policies!

I'm thrilled to accept the Rhode Island Alliance for Retirement American’s 2022 Retiree Hero Award! 

From social security to Medicare to pension reform, I've always made it my mission to support retired Rhode Islanders however I can. 

Thank you, @ActiveRetirees for your work!

By targeting hospitals, neighborhoods, and refugees, Vladimir Putin isn’t just a madman. 
 
He’s a war criminal. 
 
https://t.co/co7oUXZ7rm

I was thrilled to join Mayor Polisena this weekend to celebrate the $1.1 million in federal funding that Johnston is receiving to revive their soccer complex! 
 
Community spaces are integral to the wellness of our communities, and I am proud to be part of this project. https://t.co/nPjQWKYROL

12 years ago, the Affordable Care Act changed healthcare as we knew it. 

Since then, millions of Americans have gained coverage and millions more have seen lower premiums and Rx costs.

Healthcare is a human right, and the ACA will always be my proudest vote. #ACAIsHereToStay https://t.co/l7ZG8STr8a

My constituent, Caleb, was born with a medical condition that will require a bone graft from his hip to reconstruct his jaw. 

The Ensuring Lasting Smiles Act will require his health insurance to cover it. I proudly voted yes.  

Because everyone deserves to smile. https://t.co/Ul0bUaZ7K8

Encouraging progress here from FDA – in the digital age, medical devices must be designed to account for cyber threats that can harm patients.  

This updated guidance moves us closer to that reality. 
https://t.co/tlV5V29K3H

In the third year of a global pandemic, our collective mental health is in crisis. 

Thank you to the healthcare providers working around the clock to support our children.  

I will always fight for the resources needed to care for Rhode Islanders. 

https://t.co/xOR7AMsbs9

Federal firefighters with cancer/other illnesses have to prove their conditions were the result of their service. 

That isn't fair. 

Today, I'm voting to secure the same presumptive coverage for firefighters that vets exposed to toxins and 9/11 first responders already receive. https://t.co/RfsiHZRIoq

As SCOTUS prepares to decide the future of Roe, I wrote to @SecMayorkas re: the increasing threat posed by domestic violent extremists. 

Tonight, I’m voting to bolster security for SCOTUS justices and their families. 

Healthcare providers and patients deserve to be safe, too.

The constitutional rights of millions of women to make this very personal healthcare decision between herself and her doctor were just stripped away.

I am deeply concerned that this Court is dragging our nation in a very dangerous direction.

Thanks to the American Rescue Plan, 6,000 people in our district were able to enroll in high-quality, affordable health coverage! 

This is incredible progress, and I will continue to fight for lower healthcare costs for all Rhode Island families. https://t.co/7l9H0r6t0J

I’m always glad to see my friends from RI Developmental Disabilities Council.

Thank you to Kevin, Mike, and Chris for sharing insight on how we can strengthen Medicaid, and home- and community-based services, and economic opportunities for people with developmental disabilities. https://t.co/SDb9Vvv5tf

The Ensuring Women’s Right to Reproductive Freedom Act protects: 
🚘 The right to travel for health care 
👥 Patients and companions from prosecution 
🏥 Doctors who provide care 

I'm supporting this bill because I trust women to make health care decisions with their doctors.

The science is indisputable — access to contraception is basic healthcare.

Millions of women use birth control to make decisions about their bodies, lives, and futures.

Today, I voted for the #RightToContraception Act to ensure the Supreme Court can't ever take that right away.

The American Rescue Plan changed the course of the COVID crisis, created millions of jobs, lowered healthcare costs, helped reopen schools, and offered a little extra breathing room for Rhode Island families. 

Today, we're celebrating #500DaysofARP 🎉 https://t.co/Cxg8ByjnC7

It was great to meet with Dr. Amin and the rest of the staff at @RIHospital’s pathology lab. 

Our healthcare infrastructure has never been so important, and I’m so grateful for the work the pathology team is doing every day to keep Rhode Islanders safe and healthy. https://t.co/2r0zG5gyRd

The American Rescue Plan made health insurance affordable for millions of uninsured Americans.

The #InflationReductionAct builds on that progress by lowering health care costs and prescription drug prices for Rhode Island families.

Health care must be accessible to everyone.

We did it — the #InflationReductionAct is on its way to @POTUS's desk!
 
This historic legislation will lower the costs of energy, health care, and prescription drugs — all while protecting our environment AND reducing the deficit.
 
I'm so proud to support this bill. https://t.co/fp39SiIJaP

The #InflationReductionAct takes bold action to help Americans save money on:
💊 Prescription drugs
🩺 Health care premiums
🌎 Utility bills

And President Biden just signed it into law. 

Thank you, @POTUS!

Not sure how the Inflation Reduction Act will improve your life? 

If you are a Medicare beneficiary, here's how we're going to lower your healthcare costs! https://t.co/tnUXHj8MGU
